description: React component for a modal dialog that confirms changes to channel access rules, including user list management, search, and confirmation actions.

methods.name: loadUserProfiles
methods.description: Fetches user profiles for users to add and remove, updating component state.

methods.name: handleViewUsers
methods.description: Sets state to show detailed user list.

methods.name: handleHideUsers
methods.description: Sets state to hide detailed user list.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Filters user lists based on search input.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets state and calls onHide callback when modal is closed.
